thread:
Evan (AE): FYI Helios Medworks (EU parent + US ops) wants to move POC -> PO. Procurement asks for: multi-entity invoicing, POA for signing by US entity on behalf of EU sub, SLA with 99.95% uptime + service credits, and KYC/vendor onboarding checklist filled out. Also they redlined DPA SCCs and want data residency clause.

Harper (Legal): paste the redline excerpt? if they're making credits automatic we need caps. Also for POA we need notarized POA or eIDAS. For multi-entity invoices we need clear billing entity + intercompany statement.

Evan (AE): redline snip: 

```
SLA Sec 2.1: "Provider guarantees 99.95% availability per calendar month. Failure to meet SLA will trigger service credits equal to 10% of monthly fees for each 0.1% below threshold, uncapped."

DPA Sec 4.5: "Data processing and transfer to be governed by SCCs; Provider must store EU customer data within EU and attest monthly."
```

Jin (Security): we can't promise monthly attestation for hosted plans. We can: (a) store customer-controlled data in EU regions, (b) offer Dedicated/Private for strict residency + attestation via SOW. SCCs OK but attestation frequency must be scoped.

Luca (FinOps): on invoicing: need which legal entity will accept invoices and VAT treatment. Multi-entity billing can be done but requires billing annex: which entity pays which line items. POA OK for signature but must be attached and notarized. Net terms? default Net30 unless they request otherwise.

Harper (Legal): propose counter: cap service credits to 50% of monthly fees, remove uncapped language, and convert attestation requirement to: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide security attestations for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted plans get standard SOC2/audit reports." Add acceptable POA list in annex.

Evan (AE): I'll push back on uncapped credits, ask for PO number, billing entity, and attach their procurement contact + onboarding form. Also ask if they can accept a SOW for attestation and 30-45 day window.

vendor-onboard-bot: New vendor questionnaire uploaded: helios_vendor_onboard_2026.pdf (awaiting responses).

Jin (Security): once they complete questionnaire and confirm Dedicated/Private need, we'll open a product-ops ticket to scope attestation.

Luca (FinOps): if they want multi-entity invoicing split, have them fill the billing annex template. We'll draft an invoice mapping.

Harper (Legal): I'll draft a redline that: (1) replaces uncapped credits with a capped schedule, (2) adds "attestation by SOW" language, (3) lists POA formats (notarized POA, eIDAS advanced, corporate resolution + ID). Evan  please confirm target sign date so I can prioritize.

Evan (AE): target is EOW. pinging procurement off-thread for POA + PO#. Will update here once they reply. :thumbsup:
